character.motivation: Reuses timber from houses lost in the flood. Wants to return a few pieces before people forget where they came from.
character.voice: Thinks aloud through weight, wear, and repairs.
character.backstory: Sol reused boards from flooded homes when dry timber was scarce. Some went into repairs around town, including the farmerâ€™s cottage, and he can still recognize pieces by old nail holes and sun marks.
character.quest_hook: Sort the remaining salvage with Sol and ask its former owners what they want returned, reused, or left where it is.

dialogue.introduction: Some of the boards in your cottage used to be kitchen tables. Look underneath sometime.
dialogue.friendship: I can tell which way a table faced by the sun mark. There are whole summers in some of those boards.
dialogue.supper: The bench Niko fixed held six of us. I told him after, so he could spend the meal eating.
dialogue.hearing: If they rebuild, I'd like to make a few doors. I have some old brass that the families might recognize.
dialogue.favorite_gift: I can use that to stop the new chair legs scratching the cart.
dialogue.disliked_gift: That flower would last an hour in my workshop. Give it to someone who'll see it.

routine.job: Cuts lumber at the orchard edge
routine.hobby: Checks in at the repair yard
routine.home_context: Keeps his workshop close to Niko and above the damp that ruins salvaged boards.
